theoryOfChange: The Cancer Research Institute (CRI) has a published strategic framework called 'People × Biology × Data'. This is described as their central strategy and an innovative framework that emphasizes the integration of bioinformatics, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning to advance cancer immunotherapy. This framework guides their investments and programs to accelerate the pace of discovery and ensure that new insights are translated into effective therapies for patients. It fosters collaboration, deepens the understanding of the immune system, and leverages clinical and lab datasets to accelerate discovery and bring treatments to patients faster. This approach is detailed in their Annual Impact Reports and on their 'Our Impact' webpage.
